useful_effects: supports high-index contrast quasi-BIC and guided modes
optimization_notes: Use stable mesh before trusting peak height.
Field maps should show energy inside or near Si resonator, not only at monitor boundary.

risks: asymmetric top/bottom environment can shift BIC-like modes
optimization_notes: Check z-boundary and substrate thickness convergence for narrow peaks.

useful_effects: can create clean passband over dark background
risks: apparent Abs(T)^2 can exceed 1 in GUI extraction
optimization_notes: Any accepted physical transmittance must be <=1.
If increasing aperture improves peak then later worsens background or peak, treat as overcoupling.

risks: higher loss than Ag in many near-IR cases
optimization_notes: Use Au for robustness comparison, not necessarily peak maximization.
Do not accept PEC high peaks unless the real-material counterpart also converges physically.

general_rules: Low-loss dielectric mechanisms are preferred when strict T<=1 and clean field interpretation are required.
Metal can clean background but introduces loss and extraction pitfalls; use it as controlled coupling or shielding, not as a magic peak booster.
If material change causes peak height and background to change in opposite directions, interpret through intrinsic loss versus external coupling before scanning geometry.
